cards.title: ready /ˈrɛdi/
sections: Use two syllables. Stress the first: REA-dy. Keep the final /i/ light.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 005 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: ready
articulation.alt: ready: /r/ → /ɛ/ → /d/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
